fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our expected fuel consumption in 2008, a one dollar increase in the price of crude oil will increase our annual fuel expense by approximately $45 million (implies ~1,890 million projected gallons for 2008).

instrument_type_details.notes: At Dec 31, 2007: hedged approximately 20% of Q1 2008 and 5% of Q2 2008 projected fuel requirements using heating oil zero-cost collars (avg call $2.44/gallon, avg put $2.28/gallon). Fair value $24 million asset. Fuel hedges contributed gains of $31 million in 2007.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (millions) 1,542 [2007] 1,471 [2006] 1,376 [2005] (Item 6 selected operating data; Continental Airlines standalone)
